[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T22:01:57Z, by staff] Advocacy Group Demands Axon Halt Weapon Shipments to Israel Following Torture Allegations
The Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR) has called on Axon Enterprise to cease supplying electroshock weapons to Israel, citing reports of their use in the abuse of detainees.
The Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR) has formally demanded that Axon Enterprise, Inc. stop the shipment and servicing of its electroshock weapons to Israeli authorities. This demand follows an investigative report published by The Guardian and Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism, which alleged that Axon's devices have been used by Israeli security forces to inflict physical abuse and torture on Palestinian detainees. The report included accounts from former detainees describing the use of these weapons in detention facilities. CAIR also urged the U.S. Department of Commerce to enforce stricter export oversight regarding the transfer of such technologies to governments implicated in human rights violations.
